claim_definition: Verifies that the RAG corpus loaded at query time matches the SHA-256 digest registered in the Agent Manifest at deployment. A corpus that has been modified, poisoned, or swapped since signing causes immediate gate closure before any retrieval-augmented generation is permitted.
scope: Agent Manifest corpus binding; only-engine gateway RAG query path
excluded_scope: Streaming corpus updates; real-time knowledge bases that are designed to change after deployment

input.corpus: DGV only-engine governance corpus v0.5.0: defines policy constraints for DGV compliance framework verification across L1-compute L2-provenance L3-routing L4-evidence L5-session L6-risk L7-application.

test_cases.description: Real SHA-256 of the corpus is computed by only-gate and compared to the deliberately wrong registered digest. Gate closes on mismatch.

input.corpus: DGV only-engine governance corpus v0.5.0: defines policy constraints for DGV compliance framework verification across L1-compute L2-provenance L3-routing L4-evidence L5-session L6-risk L7-application.

test_cases.description: Positive control: only-gate computes SHA-256 of the corpus and it matches the pre-registered digest, confirming corpus integrity.
